"""Validate HTTP bearer configuration before handing authentication to the SDK."""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import re


def validate_http_auth() -> None:
    """Reject malformed or empty bearer configuration without printing credentials."""
    raw = os.environ.get("VGI_BEARER_TOKENS")
    if raw is None:
        return
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for entry in raw.split(","):
        token, separator, principal = entry.strip().partition("=")
        if (
            not separator
            or re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9._~+/\-]{32,4096}", token) is None
            or not principal
            or len(principal) > 256
            or any(char.isspace() or not char.isprintable() for char in principal)
            or token in seen
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "Invalid VGI_BEARER_TOKENS: use unique token=principal pairs separated by commas, "
                "with nonempty principals and 32-4096 character bearer tokens containing no spaces, commas, or '='"
            )
        seen.add(token)

"""Discovery metadata: the one file to edit when you rename or extend the worker.

DuckDB, coding agents and the ``vgi-lint`` metadata checker all read these
tags. Keep every object documented and ``make lint`` stays at 100.

* Catalog-level tags (title, license, author, links, long description) live in
  ``CATALOG_TAGS`` below.
* Every function and table carries ``object_tags(...)``: a title, a category
  from ``SCHEMA_CATEGORIES``, search keywords, and LLM- and human-facing docs.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from typing import Any

import pyarrow as pa
from vgi.metadata import FunctionExample

CATALOG_NAME = "treasury"

SOURCE_URL = "https://github.com/Query-farm/vgi-treasury"

# Categories group functions in docs and agent tools. Every object's
# ``vgi.category`` must name one of these.
SCHEMA_CATEGORIES = [
    {
        "name": "api",
        "title": "Economic Data",
        "description": (
            "Query federal debt, operating cash, deposits, withdrawals and public debt "
            "transactions, and discover Fiscal Data endpoint fields."
        ),
    },
]


def keywords_array(keywords: str) -> str:
    """Turn ``"a, b, c"`` into the JSON array string ``vgi.keywords`` requires."""
    return json.dumps([k.strip() for k in keywords.split(",") if k.strip()])


def object_tags(*, title: str, category: str, keywords: str, doc_llm: str, doc_md: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Build the standard per-object discovery tags."""
    if category not in {c["name"] for c in SCHEMA_CATEGORIES}:
        raise ValueError(f"unknown category {category!r}; add it to SCHEMA_CATEGORIES")
    return {
        "vgi.title": title,
        "vgi.category": category,
        "vgi.keywords": keywords_array(keywords),
        "vgi.doc_llm": doc_llm,
        "vgi.doc_md": doc_md,
    }


def column(name: str, type_: pa.DataType, comment: str, *, nullable: bool = True) -> pa.Field[Any]:
    """Build an Arrow field whose ``comment`` shows up in DuckDB's ``DESCRIBE`` and agent tools."""
    return pa.field(name, type_, nullable=nullable, metadata={b"comment": comment.encode()})


CATALOG_DOC_LLM = (
    "Query federal debt, operating cash, deposits, withdrawals and public debt "
    "transactions, and discover Fiscal Data endpoint fields. Treasury Fiscal Data is "
    "public and needs no upstream API key. Dates and currency amounts are typed, "
    "including exact decimals. Use date arguments and filters_json to reduce upstream "
    "work. page_size controls request size and max_rows=0 retrieves all matches. NULL "
    "arguments are rejected. Missing optional response fields return NULL. Upstream "
    "errors fail the query; SQL WHERE filters are local."
)
CATALOG_DOC_MD = (
    "# vgi-treasury\n\n"
    + CATALOG_DOC_LLM
    + (
        "\n\nQueries use bounded HTTP responses and retries. Credentials stay out of "
        "continuation state. See README.md for deployment and operational limits."
    )
)
SCHEMA_DOC_LLM = CATALOG_DOC_LLM
SCHEMA_DOC_MD = (
    "## main\n\n"
    + CATALOG_DOC_LLM
    + (
        "\n\nDiscover source metadata before querying observations. Use named arguments to "
        "select upstream data and ORDER BY for deterministic output."
    )
)
CATALOG_TAGS = {
    "vgi.title": "Treasury Fiscal Data",
    "vgi.subtitle": (
        "Query federal debt, operating cash, deposits, withdrawals and public debt "
        "transactions, and discover Fiscal Data endpoint fields."
    ),
    "vgi.doc_llm": CATALOG_DOC_LLM,
    "vgi.doc_md": CATALOG_DOC_MD,
    "vgi.source_url": SOURCE_URL,
    "vgi.icon_url": "https://query.farm/media-kit/products/vgi/vgi-logo.png",
    "vgi.license": "0BSD",
    "vgi.author": "Query.Farm",
    "vgi.copyright": "Copyright 2026 Query.Farm contributors",
    "vgi.keywords": keywords_array("treasury, economics, public data, time series, duckdb, sql"),
    "vgi.support_contact": "https://github.com/Query-farm/vgi-treasury/issues",
    "vgi.support_policy_url": SOURCE_URL + "/blob/main/README.md",
    "vgi.executable_examples": json.dumps(
        [
            {
                "name": "discover_datasets",
                "description": "Discover available functions without credentials or API requests",
                "sql": (
                    "SELECT function_name FROM duckdb_functions() WHERE database_name = 'treasury' AND "
                    "function_name = 'datasets' ORDER BY function_name"
                ),
                "expected_result": [{"function_name": "datasets"}],
            }
        ]
    ),
}


def function_meta(name: str, title: str, description: str, schema: pa.Schema, sql: str) -> Any:
    """Build consistent, discoverable metadata for an authenticated table function."""
    types = {
        "string": "VARCHAR",
        "int64": "BIGINT",
        "double": "DOUBLE",
        "date32[day]": "DATE",
        "bool": "BOOLEAN",
        "timestamp[us, tz=UTC]": "TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE",
    }
    docs = (
        description
        + " Returns typed columns "
        + ", ".join(schema.names)
        + ". "
        + (
            "The public upstream API needs no key. Amounts retain source scales; original source strings "
            "remain available in JSON. NULL arguments are rejected. Missing optional response fields "
            "return NULL. Upstream errors fail the query; SQL WHERE filters are local."
        )
    )

    class Meta:
        name: str
        description: str
        tags: dict[str, str]
        examples: list[FunctionExample]

    Meta.name = name
    Meta.description = description
    Meta.tags = {
        **object_tags(
            title=title,
            category="api",
            keywords=f"treasury, economics, time series, {name}",
            doc_llm=docs,
            doc_md=f"## {name}\n\n{docs}",
        ),
        "vgi.result_columns_schema": json.dumps(
            [
                {
                    "name": f.name,
                    "type": (
                        f"DECIMAL({f.type.precision}, {f.type.scale})"
                        if pa.types.is_decimal(f.type)
                        else types.get(str(f.type), str(f.type).upper())
                    ),
                    "description": (f.metadata or {}).get(b"comment", b"").decode(),
                }
                for f in schema
            ]
        ),
    }
    Meta.examples = [FunctionExample(sql=sql, description=title)]
    return Meta

"""Serve the Treasury Fiscal Data catalog over stdio, Unix sockets or HTTP.

Register new endpoints in functions.FUNCTIONS. Diagnostics use stderr; stdout
belongs exclusively to the VGI protocol when running over stdio.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from typing import Any

from vgi import Worker
from vgi.catalog import Catalog, Schema

from .api import API_SECRET_TYPES
from .auth import validate_http_auth
from .functions import FUNCTIONS
from .meta import (
    CATALOG_DOC_MD,
    CATALOG_NAME,
    CATALOG_TAGS,
    SCHEMA_CATEGORIES,
    SCHEMA_DOC_LLM,
    SCHEMA_DOC_MD,
    SOURCE_URL,
    keywords_array,
)


def _stamp_example_queries(functions: list[type[Any]]) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    """Publish each function's examples as ``vgi.example_queries`` (with descriptions).

    Overloads share one SQL name, so their examples are merged per name.
    Returns every example, for the schema-level list.
    """
    by_name: dict[str, list[dict[str, str]]] = {}
    for fn in functions:
        bucket = by_name.setdefault(fn.Meta.name, [])
        for ex in getattr(fn.Meta, "examples", []):
            entry = {"description": ex.description, "sql": ex.sql}
            if entry not in bucket:
                bucket.append(entry)
    for fn in functions:
        fn.Meta.tags = {**fn.Meta.tags, "vgi.example_queries": json.dumps(by_name[fn.Meta.name])}
    return [entry for entries in by_name.values() for entry in entries]


_ALL_EXAMPLES = _stamp_example_queries(FUNCTIONS)
CATALOG_TAGS["vgi.agent_test_tasks"] = json.dumps(
    [
        {
            "name": fn.Meta.name,
            "prompt": f"Using treasury.main.{fn.Meta.name}, {fn.Meta.examples[0].description.lower()}. "
            f"Use the arguments in this example and return the same columns: {fn.Meta.examples[0].sql}",
        }
        for fn in FUNCTIONS
    ]
    + [
        {
            "name": "weekly_debt_reconciliation",
            "prompt": (
                "Using the Treasury worker, compare two measures for the week of 2024-01-08 to 2024-01-12: the "
                "Daily Treasury Statement's net public debt issuance (all Issues minus all Redemptions across "
                "every security type, summed over those five business days) and the change in total public debt "
                "outstanding from its 2024-01-05 value to its 2024-01-12 value. Return one row with exactly the "
                "columns net_issuance_musd and debt_change_musd, both in whole USD millions as BIGINT (round the "
                "debt change to the nearest million)."
            ),
        }
    ]
)


class TreasuryWorker(Worker):
    """The worker process: one catalog, one ``main`` schema."""

    catalog = Catalog(
        name=CATALOG_NAME,
        comment=CATALOG_DOC_MD,
        source_url=SOURCE_URL,
        tags=CATALOG_TAGS,
        schemas=[
            Schema(
                path=["main"],
                comment=SCHEMA_DOC_MD,
                functions=FUNCTIONS,
                tags={
                    "vgi.title": "Treasury Functions",
                    "domain": "economics",
                    "vgi.keywords": keywords_array("treasury, fiscal data, debt, cash balances, interest rates"),
                    "vgi.doc_llm": SCHEMA_DOC_LLM,
                    "vgi.doc_md": SCHEMA_DOC_MD,
                    "vgi.categories": json.dumps(SCHEMA_CATEGORIES),
                    "vgi.example_queries": json.dumps(_ALL_EXAMPLES),
                },
            )
        ],
    )

    secret_types = API_SECRET_TYPES


def main() -> None:
    """Console-script entry point: parse ``--http`` / ``--unix`` / logging flags and serve."""
    if "--http" in sys.argv[1:]:
        try:
            validate_http_auth()
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise SystemExit(str(exc)) from None
    TreasuryWorker.main()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

[project]
name = "vgi-treasury-worker"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Treasury Fiscal Data data through typed VGI SQL functions."
readme = "README.md"
license = "0BSD"
license-files = ["LICENSE"]
requires-python = ">=3.13"
dependencies = [
    "truststore>=0.10,<1",
    # [http] adds the HTTP transport (`--http`) used by Docker deploys.
    # SDK bumps go through the template (minor bumps can raise the protocol).
    "vgi-python[http]>=0.51.1,<0.52",
]

[project.scripts]
vgi-treasury-worker = "treasury_worker.worker:main"

[dependency-groups]
dev = [
    # The pushdown recipe evaluates predicates locally; a worker that uses filter
    # pushdown must add the `haybarn` extra to its own dependencies.
    "vgi-python[haybarn]>=0.51.1,<0.52",
    "pytest>=8.4",
    "mypy>=1.18",
    "ruff>=0.14",
    "pyarrow-stubs>=20.0",
]

[build-system]
requires = ["hatchling>=1.27"]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel]
packages = ["src/treasury_worker"]

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 120
target-version = "py313"

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["E", "F", "W", "I", "N", "UP", "B", "A", "C4", "SIM", "RUF", "D"]
# RUF012: the SDK declares metadata as plain class attributes on `class Meta`.
ignore = ["D203", "D213", "RUF012"]

[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]
"tests/*" = ["D"]
"test/*" = ["D"]

[tool.mypy]
strict = true
python_version = "3.13"
files = ["src", "tests", "examples", "ci"]

[[tool.mypy.overrides]]
module = ["vgi.*", "vgi_rpc.*"]
follow_untyped_imports = true

[tool.pydoclint]
style = "google"
arg-type-hints-in-docstring = false
check-return-types = false
check-yield-types = false
allow-init-docstring = true
skip-checking-short-docstrings = true

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["tests"]
pythonpath = ["."]
